criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines name Dunleavy, SB 258, June 18, and the capital consequence (procurement leverage back to incumbents) within ~250 chars. Implies the missing statutory backstop. Missing-option hint is implicit rather than explicit, so 9 not 10.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.notes: Every story carries an AK anchor plus an industry consequence (vendor lock-in / AI tooling contracts; LNG viability and energy-cost risk; Railbelt gas and data-center siting; fiber single-point-of-failure for edge compute; DAF federal clock). ANC investment-arm reference in the close is thin.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named specifics in nearly every sentence: bill numbers, vote tallies (26-13, 12-8, 34-5), dates, Dunleavy and Tim Fitzpatrick, Glenfarne, Chugach, Enstar, GCI, Air Force, plus two verified verbatim quotes.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: All claims trace to verified_findings.json with two+ independent credible outlets (ADN, APM, KTUU, KUCB, Offshore Energy, HigherGov). Both verbatim quotes confirmed. SB 258 AI tie labeled analytical and framed as such. Most items secondary-credible rather than first-listed primary docket, so 9 not 10.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Reads close to post_001.md: analytical, position-taking, structural, business-literate, no influencer cadence, no banned phrases. 'Now the contrast.' is a slightly abrupt opener but stays in register.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 444 words in range, ~2781 chars under cap. Six of seven paragraphs are 2-4 sentences; P4 (HB 381) runs five sentences, the only slightly dense block. No bullet block.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Real, debatable question tied to the public/private tension developed throughout. No softener, no CTA. 'federal lease clock' is compressed shorthand for the DAF deadline.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: At least four revisit-this-week triggers: June 29 DAF deadline, June 20 second special session, GCI fiber single-point risk, SB 258 veto's vendor lock-in consequence.

one_sentence_fix: Optional: split paragraph 4 (HB 381) after the Fitzpatrick quote to cap all paragraphs at four sentences for better mobile scan.
